data.name: Noman
data.gender_notes: Noman is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ن-ع-م (n-ʿ-m); Nuʿmān is a classical Arabic name. Its root is ن-ع-م (n-ʿ-m). Borne by Nuʿmān ibn Thābit (Abū Ḥanīfa). Noman is a Arabic name meaning “Blood; (also) a companion's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Noman expresses “Blood; (also) a companion's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ن-ع-م (n-ʿ-m); Nuʿmān is a classical Arabic name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noman total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
